stemMd: A cube has surface area 150 square centimeters. What is its volume?
explanationMd: For edge s, 6s²=150, so s²=25 and s=5. Volume is s³=125 cubic centimeters. Surface area and volume use different powers of length.

distractorRationale.d: This raises the edge length to the fourth power.
distractorRationale.c: This is the area of one face, not volume.
distractorRationale.b: This does not follow the cube formulas.
